claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.proximity_to_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD activation condition 'while you are within 5 feet of this brazier' is a proximity gate on a stationary wondrous item (a brazier is not held or worn). No existing EquipmentPredicate variant covers proximity to a non-carried object. The censer analogously used holding_item because swinging implies holding, but the brazier cannot use that fiction — it is floor/table-placed furniture.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental.
